points.description: States that an orthotropic material has material properties that differ along three mutually perpendicular (orthogonal) axes (at a point).
points.partial_credit: Half if says properties differ with direction/are not the same in all directions, without mentioning three perpendicular axes.

points.description: States that an orthotropic material has 9 independent elastic constants.
points.partial_credit: Half if gives a number of constants close but not 9, or just says it needs several elastic constants.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both ideas: properties differ along three orthogonal axes, and there are 9 elastic constants, in any wording. Give part marks for a vague version, e.g. properties vary with direction. Give no marks for wrong definitions such as properties being the same in all directions (isotropic).
